cases.prompt: A synthetic proposal claims to be a closed-loop habitat because lighting energy is metered and most water is recovered. Its production boundary omits pumps, its A03 ledger has nonzero residuals, its plant evidence cites Zong without the 2025 correction and Jin, and its support concept changed after scheduling began. The proposal also treats a missing temperature field as zero and calls two reused scenario rows independent reliability evidence. Write an integrative review that corrects the boundaries, identifies the necessary comparisons and records, and states exactly which human reviews remain unresolved.

rubric.criterion: Expands the production and resource boundaries to include pumps, external dependencies, residuals and waste or support flows rather than accepting a lighting-only account
Requires timer, spatial PPFD, actual power, calibration and missing-data evidence without confusing setpoints or absent values with measured outcomes
Adds Zong correction provenance and Jin unintended-variant context, separates molecular and system outcomes, and supplies no operational editing content
Traces the changed support concept to its load-path, dependency, permission and inspection implications and returns it to named human gates
Recomputes A03 residuals, treats A04 temperature as missing and reports reused rows as descriptive rather than independent replication
Concludes with a bounded non-operational handoff that makes no construction, habitability, life-support or field-performance claim

limitations: A zero-point self-check on an entirely synthetic proposal; it is not a grade, qualified review, construction approval or life-support assessment.

cases.prompt: Milestone 1: define the concept and its boundaries. Using only synthetic site records, draw production and support boundaries, reconcile land and water inventories, and list local review questions and external dependencies.

rubric.criterion: Separates production zones, paths, support equipment, external energy, water and waste routes with explicit synthetic assumptions
Recomputes the declared area and water-stock balances and avoids interpreting closure as impact or sustainability proof
Lists local land-use, safety, environmental and community review questions without treating arithmetic as permission

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one optional synthetic project milestone; it is not a grade, qualified review or operational authorization.

cases.prompt: Milestone 2: connect light, time, energy and resource inventories. Compute the rehearsal DLI and water balance, state timer and sensor evidence needed, and explain why those results do not prescribe crop response or nutrient dosing.

rubric.criterion: Recomputes R02 DLI as 11.088 mol m⁻² d⁻¹ and R03 closing stock as 92 L with units and synthetic provenance
Specifies independent timer-state, actual-power, spatial PPFD, calibration and missing-sensor evidence
Separates engineering quantities from plant response and supplies no nutrient formulation or dosing recipe

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one optional synthetic project milestone; it is not a grade, qualified review or operational authorization.

cases.prompt: Milestone 3: join biological evidence and construction planning. Write a correction-aware plant evidence note and a conceptual load-path/work-breakdown note with dependencies and human gates, without operational editing or construction instructions.

rubric.criterion: Cites Zong with its 2025 correction and Jin separately, uses controls/comparators and bounds molecular, phenotype and system claims
Traces conceptual forces to the foundation boundary and gives unique work items, predecessors and a longest-path calculation
Names qualified design, permission, inspection and change-control gates while excluding physical procedures and design approval

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one optional synthetic project milestone; it is not a grade, qualified review or operational authorization.

cases.prompt: Milestone 4: test the outage and audit evidence. Recompute the rehearsal outage energy, all supplied audit-row balances and the A03 residuals, then classify missing data and correlated-row limitations.

rubric.criterion: Recomputes R04 as 1.8 kWh before reserves or conversion losses and states the critical-load and duration assumptions
Finds A03 residuals of +1.2 kWh and +2 L and checks every other row rather than reporting only favourable balances
Preserves the A04 missing-temperature gap and reports A01/A06 and other reused scenarios descriptively, not as independent reliability evidence

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one optional synthetic project milestone; it is not a grade, qualified review or operational authorization.

cases.prompt: Milestone 5: deliver the bounded evidence package. Assemble the five milestone records, assumptions, source links, synthetic-data declarations, residuals and unresolved human decisions into a final handoff and explicit non-operational statement.

rubric.criterion: Indexes all five milestone records to their readings, public practice, synthetic CSV rows and link-only source records
States assumptions, nonzero residuals, evidence gaps, comparator needs and unresolved engineering, local and scientific reviews
Declares the package optional, zero-point, formative and non-operational, with no nutrient recipe, editing protocol, construction authorization or life-support claim

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one optional synthetic project milestone; it is not a grade, qualified review or operational authorization.
